defects.justification: image.Decode is called on an arbitrary uploaded file without first checking dimensions via image.DecodeConfig; a tiny PNG/GIF declaring e.g. 50000x50000 pixels makes the decoder allocate gigabytes (decompression bomb), crashing the service from one unauthenticated request.

All endpoints, including DELETE /files/{name} and uploads, are unauthenticated: anyone who can reach the service can delete every stored file or fill the disk (no quota). README acknowledges it, but it should not go to production this way.
http.Server sets only ReadHeaderTimeout; with 100 MB uploads and no ReadTimeout/WriteTimeout/IdleTimeout, slow-body clients can pin goroutines and file descriptors indefinitely.
writeJSON discards the json.Encode error, so failed responses go unlogged.
